extraction.name: OpenThoughts3-1.2M
extraction.description: A 1.2 million-sized dataset for training reasoning models, containing 850,000 math, 250,000 code, and 100,000 science datapoints generated through a pipeline of question sourcing, filtering, deduplication, and answer generation using teacher models.
extraction.creator: Etash Guha, Ryan Marten, Sedrick Keh, Negin Raoof, Georgios Smymis, et al.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The data collection involves sourcing questions from existing datasets and synthetic generation, mixing top sources, filtering for quality using LLMs and fastText, deduplicating, and generating multiple answers per question using a teacher model (QwQ-32B).
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: OpenMath-2-Math, CodeGolf, OpenCodeReasoning, StackExchangePhysics, OrganicChemistryPDFs, NuminaMath, AutoMathText, OpenR1, CodeFeedback, TACO, Apps, CodeContests
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Decontamination against evaluation benchmarks using Indel similarity and N-gram similarity; Deduplication (exact and fuzzy); Sampling multiple answers (16x) per question.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Filtering questions using difficulty-based selection (GPT-4o-mini) for code and response length filtering (GPT-4.1-mini) for math and science; Exact deduplication for math and science, no deduplication for code; Filtering out non-English answers and long paragraphs (though found ineffective).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Generating answers using a teacher model (QwQ-32B) with 16x sampling per question. Previous versions used DeepSeek-R1.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Filtering answers (verification, majority consensus, length) did not improve performance over using all samples. The shortest response strategy often outperforms the longest.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: QwQ-32B, DeepSeek-R1, GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4.1-mini, GPT-4.1-nano, FastText
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The OpenThoughts project involves continuous releases (BespokeStratos-17K, OpenThoughts-114K, OpenThoughts2-1M, OpenThoughts3-1.2M). Datasets and models are available on openthoughts.ai.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Supervised fine-tuning on reasoning inadvertently degrades the preexisting safety alignment of models, creating a trade-off between reasoning capabilities and safety.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Distilled reasoning models suffer from generalization deficits, showing strong performance fluctuations on reasoning-invariant problem perturbations (Alice in Wonderland evaluation). Models with better performance are not necessarily better teachers (QwQ-32B is a stronger teacher than DeepSeek-R1 despite lower scores).
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Did not explore datasets for reinforcement learning or staged SFT/curriculum learning. Distilled models suffer from generalization deficits. Safety alignment degrades with SFT on reasoning data.
